corpus: 10 failing logs, 975 lines. 4 verbatim GitHub Actions logs (gh run view --log, 2026-11-21) and 6 reproductions: the real tool run on a real repo copy with a real defect introduced. The defect class in each reproduction is one that actually failed in these repos before; the LearnLLM mypy case is the exact error from that repo's capstone-ci. Nothing was edited in the real repos.

logs.cause: Chrome did not open a debugging port in the Build step; the change itself passed every other step. Environment/tooling failure, fixed the same day by PR #29, which hardened the Chrome launcher (Chrome for Testing, --remote-debugging-port=0, 60s wait, 3 retries).
ground_truth: Chrome did not open a debugging port
logs.source: GitHub Actions run 44135960638, sine-portfolio CI, 2026-11-17 (merge PR #28). Verbatim download.

logs.cause: PyYAML ships no type stubs and types-PyYAML was not installed. Fixed in LearnLLM by adding types-PyYAML to the dev extras.

logs.cause: ModuleNotFoundError for _missing_dep_xyz imported at tests/conftest.py:1; every test errors at setup. A defect (a bad import line), not a missing package.
logs.source: Reproduction: retriever-doc-answer tests with a bad import added to tests/conftest.py, pytest run in the jokeGPT venv. One broken import fails every test.

scoring: A method 'names the cause' only if the text it surfaces contains every ground-truth substring. Ground truth is the root cause as established by the fix that actually resolved the failure.
